title: Not terrible but could use some improvement;
text:
I really wanted to love this but I have a few serious cons:

1. Plastic packaging. Plastic coated info cards. Just.. so much plastic.
2. The reusable tea bags work well but I had to flip them inside out and sew them. They are not well made for the long run.
3. The flavorings were too much. The tea is good, don't get me wrong, but it's way too intense. I made my cups at half the strength recommended and it was still.. a lot.

Overall I really like the idea of this but it has a lot of room for improvement.
label: neutral
